title: 1st G20 Education Working Group Meeting at IITM Research Park, Chennai, on January 31, 2023
description: IIT Madras is organising a G20 seminar on the ‘Role of Digital Technology in Education’ at IITM Research Park, on Jan 31, 2023, at #Chennai. The  G20 India seminar will focus on strengthening the use of digital technologies to enhance student learning opportunities and outcomes and leverage digital technologies for the education of special children. First G20 Education Working Group Meeting is organised as part of India’s Presidency of G20, with a key objective being to identify areas or themes for promoting possible research & academic collaboration among educational institutions in G20 member countries.
